tools.name: convert_pdf_preview
tools.description: Convert a PDF URL into a stored preview for the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the forms:read scope. Returns the preview id and expiry. For a preview without a key, use preview_volunteer_form.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List forms that belong to the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the forms:read scope.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Get one form by id when it belongs to the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the forms:read scope.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List applications for one form in the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the applications:read scope.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Get one application by id when it belongs to the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the applications:read scope.

tools.name: update_application_status
tools.description: Set an application's status for the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key with the applications:write scope. A decline requires a decline reason. This writes the status; it does not delete the application.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_preview, grade_form, convert_pdf_preview, create_form_from_pdf · Private data: preview_volunteer_form, get_preview, grade_form, convert_pdf_preview, list_forms, get_form, list_applications, get_application, update_application_status, create_form_from_pdf · Public sink: preview_volunteer_form, grade_form, create_form_from_pdf · Destructive: update_application_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_preview, grade_form, convert_pdf_preview, create_form_from_pdf · Private data: preview_volunteer_form, get_preview, grade_form, convert_pdf_preview, list_forms, get_form, list_applications, get_application, update_application_status, create_form_from_pdf · Public sink: preview_volunteer_form, grade_form, create_form_from_pdf · Destructive: update_application_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
